xmldoc.short_description: Canonical form of a time zone name.

param_input_item.param_description: a string: time zone name, 'local', 'UTC', 'GMT', 'Z' or an offset such as '+2', 'UTC+0530' or '-03:00'.
a string: folder of the time zone database to use. An empty value keeps the current setting.

param_output_item.param_description: a character vector: the canonical time zone name.

description.p: timezonename checks a time zone name and returns the form stored in the TimeZone property of a datetime. It is a low-level function used by datetime.

ul.li: an offset written '+H', '+HH', '+HHMM' or '+HH:MM', with an optional 'UTC' or 'GMT' prefix, gives '+HH:MM' (same for '-').
'local' gives the name of the operating system time zone when a database is set, 'local' otherwise.
a database name is returned as is; fixed offset zones of the 'Etc/' family are written as '+HH:MM' (for example 'Etc/GMT+5' gives '-05:00').
an empty name is returned empty.

description.p: Without a database, only a short list of common zones is known. An unknown name raises the error Nelson:datetime:UnknownTimeZone.
When dataPath is given, it becomes the database folder of all the time zone functions for the rest of the session.

example_item.example_item_data: dataPath = [modulepath('time'), '/resources/tzdata']; timezonename('gmt') timezonename('UTC+2') timezonename('Europe/Paris', dataPath) timezonename('Etc/GMT+5', dataPath)
